name: data-table
title: DataTable
description: A virtualized table of rows on UI SDK's virtualizer, grid focus and resize: typed columns (fixed or flexible widths, a header and a cell, as TanStack's ColumnDef, a sort value), sort, column resize, single selection or none, density, a size class of its own (bindSizeClass) that hides columns and stacks the rows when it is narrow, a toolbar, a footer, a loading state and an EmptyState, and an optional current time for rows on a timeline. An APG grid with one tab stop and cell focus (or row focus). Stays smooth at 100,000 rows. RequestTable and the SQL console's results are presets of it.
